item.tib: byams ma rigs kyi 'jigs skyobs kyi phyag bzhes gsal byed rgyan gyi dga' ston
item.coloph: ces pa 'di yang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhan zur mchog gi zhal khrid ji lta ba ma nor bar/ gong ma'i gdan sa bru yi sgrub gnas bya dur gnam thos ri khrod du/ sgo rigs kyi bla ming rnam rgyal tshul khrims du 'bod pa bdag gis sbyar bas/ nor 'khrul byung na skyabs gnas tshogs la bshags/ dge bas 'gro la phan pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig/
